title: Supervision model and assignment workflow
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.

models.name: SupervisionDocument
models.work: per supervisor per year: capacity and assigned teams

build: Spec amendment A2: add to TeamDocument `supervisor_assignment?: { status: 'proposed' | 'accepted' | 'declined'; proposed_by: string; proposed_at: Timestamp; window_expires_at: Timestamp; responded_at?: Timestamp; decline_reason?: string; override_reason?: string }`. Update src/types/firestore.ts, docs/models.md and leave a note in docs/fypms-docs.md section 13.

models/supervision (schema, repo): doc id `${supervisorUid}__${academicYearId}`, max_capacity from the supervisor's profile.max_team_capacity (default 5). ensureSupervisionDoc(supervisorUid, yearId) is called from update-profile when a supervisor completes their profile, plus scripts/backfill-supervisions.ts for existing supervisors.

src/app/actions/get-supervisor-recommendations.ts (coordinator/admin): team tags = union of tech_stack of the team's current topics (approved topic if present); candidates from staff_whitelist + supervisions; returns rankSupervisors output.

src/app/actions/propose-supervisor.ts (coordinator/admin): supervisor must list the team's course_id unless override_reason is supplied (then writeAudit supervision.override); sets team.assigned_supervisor_id and supervisor_assignment proposed with window_expires_at = now + SUPERVISOR_RESPONSE_WINDOW_HOURS (72); notify the supervisor (supervision_assignment). An expired proposal may be replaced.

src/app/actions/respond-supervisor-assignment.ts (the proposed supervisor only): accept runs a transaction: window not expired, supervision.current_assigned_count < max_capacity (else 409), increment count, arrayUnion team id, set status at_capacity when full, mark accepted, call ensureContactGrants, notify team and coordinators. Decline clears assigned_supervisor_id, records the reason, notifies coordinators.
Server tests: programme filter and override audit, capacity race (two accepts at count = max - 1), expiry, decline path, grants created only after both acceptance and approved topic.
assumptions: Response window is 72 hours (constant, spec says 'designated window')
Matching uses the union of the team's current topic tags
acceptance: A supervisor outside the course appears only through an audited override
